name: breadcrumb
description: Breadcrumb trail — a <nav aria-label="Breadcrumb"> with link items, presentational separators, and the current page marked aria-current="page"

changes.note: Nested components keep their own parts. The stylesheet reached the list, items, separators and current page with descendant selectors, so a component nested inside with parts of the same name took this one's styles. Parts are root > list > separator and root > list > li > item or current. Every part rule is now a child chain from the root, with the hops in :where(), so no rule changes specificity. No change for markup that follows the template.

The root sets overflow-wrap: anywhere, so a crumb that is one unbreakable token (an id, a slug) breaks onto further lines instead of widening the page. Crumbs with ordinary break opportunities wrap where they always did. Inside a table cell the table's own wrapping applies instead (table 3.2.1).

item.description: A navigable crumb — an anchor with an href

separator.description: Presentational separator between crumbs — must be aria-hidden="true"; a default glyph is supplied by CSS when left empty

current.description: The current page — non-interactive, must carry aria-current="page"

--breadcrumb-separator.description: Glyph rendered for empty separators (custom property)

a11y.notes: The root must be a <nav> with aria-label="Breadcrumb" (or aria-labelledby). Separators are decorative and must be aria-hidden="true". Only the current page carries aria-current="page", and it is not a link.
